decisions.reason: The rectangle identity gives the Z marginal by setting A=E_X and B=E_Y with C arbitrary, not C=E_Z. Repaired that immediate marginal calculation. The supplied simultaneous-uniqueness lemma explicitly requires AC, already in Given/A1; made that hypothesis visible in the Statement. Product-kernel composition and equality outside the union of the two null sets then prove existence and version independence.

The original KL compares P_XYZ on X×Y×Z to R on Z×X×Y, so it is undefined for distinct carriers. Both laws now explicitly use Z,X,Y and P_ZXY. Rectangle construction supplies a probability reference independent of kernel versions; explicit AC carries the conditional-law and KL interfaces. MIT 6.441 Chapter 2 Definition 2.4 confirms the product-of-conditional-marginals construction; this repair uses the local joint-law lemma rather than assuming a joint density.

The finite-KL bridge explicitly assumes AC for the measurable-space KL interface. Added that existing Given/A1 assumption to the Statement. At p=0 or 1 both laws are the same point mass. For 0<p<1 the diagonal ratios are 1/p and 1/(1-p), giving exactly the asserted finite entropy; no arbitrary finite density selection is needed. Also removed the premature internal tag in step 1.2.

Disintegration and simultaneous uniqueness explicitly assume AC, which the original Statement omitted. Added AC. For finite i,j, the two disintegrations give equality of the event integrals of p_i m_ij and p_ij; testing strict discrepancy sets proves their almost-everywhere equality on one common finite-union null set. The finite rowwise logarithm identity integrates to the chain rule, including zero rows. Version invariance now explicitly covers (X,U)|Z, and finiteness uses the supplied |alphabet|/e bound.

The countable determining-algebra supplier assumes AC, and countable union of arbitrary finite atom sets uses it; made this hypothesis explicit in the Statement and A1. Each mass-threshold set is finite. On countable full support the explicit diagonal density is 1/p_i and monotone convergence gives the entropy sum. Otherwise the measurable diagonal outside S×S has positive joint mass and zero product mass by its singleton sections, so KL is infinite. MIT Chapter 2 Theorem 2.4(1) supplies the same complete diagonal-null-set argument.

The original equality criterion compared P_XYZ to a Z,X,Y law and concluded equality on C×A×B without a coordinate permutation. Repaired both directions to use P_ZXY. KL=0 iff equality of probability measures gives the law criterion; conditioning-event tests give the indicator factorization, and bounded simple approximation gives all bounded f,g. The reverse indicator identity determines the entire law by pi-lambda. AC is now explicit as required by KL and conditional independence.

The Lebesgue definition explicitly postpones countable additivity to its complete-measure theorem. Added that existing published theorem to deps and F1, so restriction to Borel subsets is a countably additive measure, and the box theorem normalizes it and makes every singleton null. Explicit AC supplies countable choice and the repaired law-entropy theorem. The empty atomic set gives infinite self-MI, while the density 1_[0,1] has identically zero f ln f and differential entropy zero.
